# Parag Gupta

> DevOps Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer. Building resilient
> infrastructure and automation — from Kubernetes clusters to AI-augmented
> observability tooling.

Parag Gupta is a DevOps/SRE engineer currently a Computer Scientist at Adobe
(Dec 2021–present), with prior roles at Media.net, Tokopedia, Paytm, and
TO THE NEW. Background spans Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, multi-cloud
infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure, Alibaba Cloud), and, more recently,
AI-augmented observability tooling. Active open-source contributor, with a
merged fix in systemd.

## Projects

- Cortex VM Analyzer — AI-based root cause analysis comparing an unhealthy VM's metrics, down to the process level, against a healthy peer: https://github.com/paraggupta10/cortex-vm-analyzer
- Lens: Multi-Agent Monitoring Assistant — Google ADK-based multi-agent assistant replacing manual metrics/logs/database investigation with a single chat interface: https://github.com/paraggupta10/lens
- terraform-mongodbatlas-indexes — public Terraform module for declarative MongoDB Atlas index management: https://github.com/paraggupta10/terraform-mongodbatlas-indexes (also on the Terraform Registry: https://registry.terraform.io/modules/paraggupta10/indexes/mongodbatlas/latest)
- Kubernetes HA Cluster — 3-master-node HA Kubernetes cluster on CentOS, documented in a published blog post: https://www.tothenew.com/blog/how-to-setup-kubernetes-master-ha-on-centos/
- Distributed Tracing Platform Rollout — zero-code distributed tracing across a Java microservices platform, adopted org-wide as the standard integration pattern
- Open source contribution — merged fix to systemd adding zsh shell-completion support for `systemctl show`: https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/43500
